# DAIV

> DAIV is an open-source, self-hosted SWE agent for GitLab and GitHub that turns issues into merge requests, answers review comments, and fixes failing CI.

DAIV is an open-source async software engineering agent that integrates natively with GitLab and GitHub through webhooks. Create an issue, get a merge request. Mention DAIV in a review, get the fix. Licensed under Apache 2.0.


## Getting Started

- [Quickstart](https://docs.daivagent.com/dev/getting-started/quickstart/index.md): Try DAIV in about 15 minutes: run it on one Linux machine with Docker Compose, connect a GitLab project, and turn a labelled issue into a merge request.
- [Deployment](https://docs.daivagent.com/dev/getting-started/deployment/index.md): Deploy a self-hosted DAIV instance with Docker Swarm or Docker Compose: PostgreSQL, Redis, the DAIV app, worker, scheduler and sandbox.
- [Platform setup](https://docs.daivagent.com/dev/getting-started/platform-setup/index.md): Connect DAIV to GitLab (GitLab.com or self-hosted) or GitHub so it can address issues, review merge and pull requests, and react to webhooks.
- [Accounts and roles](https://docs.daivagent.com/dev/getting-started/accounts/index.md): How sign-in works in the DAIV dashboard: admin and member roles, Git platform OAuth, one-time email codes or passkeys, the first admin, and managing users.
- [LLM providers](https://docs.daivagent.com/dev/getting-started/llm-providers/index.md): Configure the LLM providers DAIV runs on (OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini or a custom provider) and how models are specified.

## Features

- [Issue addressing](https://docs.daivagent.com/dev/features/issue-addressing/index.md): DAIV reads a labelled GitLab or GitHub issue, proposes an implementation plan, waits for your approval, then opens a merge or pull request with the code.
- [Pull request assistant](https://docs.daivagent.com/dev/features/pull-request-assistant/index.md): Mention DAIV in a GitLab merge request or GitHub pull request to apply review feedback, answer questions about the change, or fix failing pipelines.
- [Pipeline watch](https://docs.daivagent.com/dev/features/pipeline-watch/index.md): After DAIV publishes a merge request it watches CI and spends a bounded number of agent runs making it green, then reports any jobs still failing.
- [Repository memory](https://docs.daivagent.com/dev/features/memory/index.md): DAIV extracts observations from finished runs, consolidates them into a short per-repository document (dreaming), and adds that document to the system prompt of later runs on the same repository.
- [Sessions](https://docs.daivagent.com/dev/features/sessions/index.md): Every DAIV agent execution is recorded as a session: chat with the agent live, start background runs, and review transcripts, timelines and usage.
- [Jobs API](https://docs.daivagent.com/dev/features/jobs-api/index.md): Trigger DAIV agents programmatically with the Jobs REST API from CI pipelines, scripts or other tools: submit a prompt, get a job ID, poll the result.
- [Scheduled jobs](https://docs.daivagent.com/dev/features/scheduled-jobs/index.md): Run DAIV agents on a cron schedule across one or more repositories for recurring work such as dependency audits and nightly code-quality scans.
- [Orchestration](https://docs.daivagent.com/dev/features/orchestration/index.md): Let the DAIV agent delegate work to independent jobs on other repositories or new sessions on the same one, then report the combined outcome.
- [MCP endpoint](https://docs.daivagent.com/dev/features/mcp-endpoint/index.md): Connect Claude Code, Cursor or Codex CLI to DAIV over the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and delegate coding tasks to the agent from your editor.
- [Notifications](https://docs.daivagent.com/dev/features/notifications/index.md): Get notified when a DAIV run needs attention, via the in-app bell, email, Rocket.Chat or Telegram, with per-user delivery channels.
- [Merge metrics](https://docs.daivagent.com/dev/features/merge-metrics/index.md): Track code merged across your repositories with diff statistics and commit-level attribution of changes to DAIV or human authors.
- [Slash commands and skills](https://docs.daivagent.com/dev/features/slash-commands/index.md): Slash commands and skills DAIV responds to in issue and merge or pull request comments, including /plan and /code-review, plus your own custom skills.
- [Subagents](https://docs.daivagent.com/dev/features/subagents/index.md): How DAIV's main agent delegates to specialized subagents for fast codebase exploration and complex multi-step tasks, and how to list them with /agents.
- [Sandbox](https://docs.daivagent.com/dev/features/sandbox/index.md): DAIV runs shell commands in an isolated Docker container powered by daiv-sandbox, to run tests, install dependencies, execute linters and inspect git history.
- [Sandbox environments](https://docs.daivagent.com/dev/features/sandbox-environments/index.md): Define named, reusable DAIV sandbox environments with a base image, CPU and memory limits, network egress policy, encrypted secrets and repository scope.

## Integrations

- [Request Tracker triage](https://docs.daivagent.com/dev/integrations/rt/index.md): Trigger DAIV on new Request Tracker tickets with a single RT scrip: it triages each ticket, analyses root causes in code, and posts an internal comment.

## Customization

- [Repository configuration](https://docs.daivagent.com/dev/customization/repository-config/index.md): Configure DAIV per repository with a .daiv.yml file: who can trigger it, which diff content it omits, feature toggles and model overrides.
- [Agent skills](https://docs.daivagent.com/dev/customization/agent-skills/index.md): Create custom agent skills for DAIV: SKILL.md directories with specialized instructions and workflows that the agent follows when they are triggered.
- [MCP tools](https://docs.daivagent.com/dev/customization/mcp-tools/index.md): Extend DAIV's agent with external services over the Model Context Protocol (MCP): built-in servers such as Sentry, custom servers and personal servers.

## Reference

- [Environment variables](https://docs.daivagent.com/dev/reference/env-variables/index.md): Reference for every environment variable that configures DAIV, including which ones are sensitive and should be provided as Docker secrets.
- [Site configuration](https://docs.daivagent.com/dev/reference/site-configuration/index.md): The admin-only DAIV Site Configuration UI: tune agent models, tools, LLM providers and OAuth login at runtime, with environment variables taking precedence.
- [Agent tools](https://docs.daivagent.com/dev/reference/agent-architecture/index.md): The tools the DAIV agent has, when each is available, and how it loads the ones it uses less often.
- [Monitoring](https://docs.daivagent.com/dev/reference/monitoring/index.md): Trace DAIV agent runs with LangSmith, read the trace tags and metadata, build the dashboard, check token usage and cost, export session archives and read the log events.
- [Management commands](https://docs.daivagent.com/dev/reference/management-commands/index.md): Reference for every django-admin management command DAIV ships: what each one does, whether and when it runs on its own, its options and an example run inside the container.
- [Benchmarks](https://docs.daivagent.com/dev/reference/benchmarks/index.md): How DAIV's /code-review scores on the ReviewBench test set: precision and recall by category and severity, cost and time per review, the method and its limits.

## Community

- [Community](https://docs.daivagent.com/dev/community/index.md): Contribute to DAIV, the open-source SWE agent for GitLab and GitHub: code, docs, testing or feedback. Report issues and find project resources.
